who: Robert W. Smith, historian of science at the University of Alberta; PhD in History and Philosophy of Science, Cambridge, 1979.

Authority identifies Robert W. (Robert William) Smith as the author of The expanding universe (1982), then assistant keeper of physical sciences at the Merseyside museums; the CV records the same work and appointment.

notes: The matching candidate is p-131966. The named supervisees directly establish the identity; the CV gives slightly different completion years for Gainor and Eisler from the AHA entries.
